expense_ratio.footnote: Rolling T12 expense ratio per property; one point per monthly statement. Monthly ratios within a statement are volatile on an accrual basis — the T12 figure is the reliable KPI. The numerator is the statement's total expenses row where it has one (the same figure the Operating Summary card shows), and its recoverable operating total where it does not — so the ratio is not comparable between properties whose statements are on different account trees — the basis above the chart is the selected property's own.
